description: Blacksmith's wall tool rack (back against a wall at +Y): oak board ~1.3 m x 0.16 m with iron pegs; two hammers hang by their heads, handles down; punches and cold chisels hang through a drilled oak strip by their mushroomed heads; tongs hang from a peg on the right. Origin at the bottom of the lowest tool: mount with the base ~0.95 m up (board at ~1.25-1.4 m).

paint.prompt: a sooty rough oak board; black hand-forged iron hammer heads, punches, chisels and tongs with hammer marks and rust spots; worn smooth pale ash hammer handles darkened by hands
